paper.title_en: Probing the dynamical inverse seesaw mechanism with low-frequency gravitational waves
paper.abstract_en: We study the possibility of probing the dynamical inverse seesaw mechanism for the origin of light neutrino masses via the detection of stochastic gravitational waves (GW) in the low-frequency regime currently being probed by pulsar timing arrays. As the lepton number-violating term in inverse seesaw typically remains in the sub-MeV ballpark, its dynamical origin naturally brings the possibility of a low-scale first-order phase transition, which can be probed at low-frequency GW experiments. We also find interesting complementarity with heavy neutral lepton searches, as GW experiments remain sensitive to parameter space with small active-sterile mixing, which is out of reach for most particle physics experiments.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将逆跷跷板机制中轻中微子质量起源的动力学实现与脉冲星计时阵列所探测的低频随机引力波联系起来，涉及低能标一阶相变及与重中性轻子搜寻的互补性，与PTA主题直接相关，理论动机和可探测参数空间讨论较清晰，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 用低频引力波探测动力学逆跷跷板机制
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了通过探测低频波段中的随机引力波（GW）来检验轻中微子质量起源的动力学逆跷跷板机制的可能性，该波段目前正由脉冲星计时阵列进行探测。由于逆跷跷板机制中破坏轻子数的项通常保持在亚MeV量级，其动力学起源自然带来了低能标一阶相变的可能性，而这一相变可在低频引力波实验中被探测。我们还发现了与重中性轻子搜寻之间有趣的互补性，因为引力波实验仍然对活性—惰性混合较小的参数空间保持敏感，而这超出了大多数粒子物理实验的探测范围。
